newsitem.title: EGYPT: East Delta Mills says 1995/6 profits up.
newsitem.headline: East Delta Mills says 1995/6 profits up.

text.p: East Delta Flour Mills made net after-tax profits of 27.773 million pounds in the financial year 1995/6, about half a percent up on 27.618 million in 1994/5, according to audited results available on Sunday.
Turnover rose to 389.631 million pounds, 10.6 percent up on 352.373 million in the previous year, and profits before tax were 35.024 million, 5.0 percent up on 33.37 million.
The state is in the process of selling at least 40 percent of the company's six million shares to the private sector at 31.00 pounds each. The shares have not yet traded on the exchange.
